unresolvedBuildInputs: Exact Android dependency/toolchain patch versions and verification hashes at M1
Source-built archive parser and signature verifier dependencies at M2
Ubuntu 24.04 ARM64 and x86_64 signed package snapshots, package closures and image digests
FEX recursive submodule pins and Linux ARM64 toolchain/container digest
Reproducible artifact digests, inventories, SBOMs and corresponding-source packages
Release catalog trust root, signature algorithm, rotation and freshness policy
releaseRequirements: Locked source, submodule, toolchain and authenticated package inputs
Actual artifact hashes and byte counts; no placeholder digests
Successful independent repeat builds and ABI/loader checks
Applicable milestone evidence under installed app UID
